item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane, tropical storm] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 1 dead in Hawaii as Lala, now a tropical storm, moves west
item.description: One person is dead and tens of thousands have lost power after Hurricane Lala lashed parts of Hawaii overnight, before weakening slightly Sunday morning to a tropical storm.
